names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 14 iunie, «Sfântul Proroc Elisei».

Read out of saint.gr's line for 14 Ιουνίου, «Προφήτης Ελισσαίος», with the rank word left off. The page's hymns spell the name «Ἐλισαῖε» as well as «Ἐλισσαῖε»; the form above is the one the day's line prints.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 14. јун ст. ст., „Свети пророк Јелисеј“ — Свети is not a rank and пророк is the rank, which `types` already carries; both come off and the bare forename is left, which is all the heading gives. `foldchk.py` holds no folder on «Јелисеј», so there is no fold — and the Serbian vernacular form is nothing like the English Elisha, which is the false negative §7 of the brief warns about: the folder was found by the candidate scan’s menologion day and not by any reading of the name.

Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru’s line for 14 июня ст. ст., «Пророк Елисей» (name page 764), with the rank word left off. The line itself gives the name in the genitive and the name page carries no surname and no epithet, so the form is bare; before it was stored no folder in the corpus held this key.

feast.note: The same menologion number this folder’s romanian, greek and serbian rows already carry, so there is no second day.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 14 июня ст. ст. — «Прор. Елисея (IX до Р.Х.).»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 14 iunie — «Sfântul Proroc Elisei»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 14ης Ιουνίου — «Προφήτης Ελισσαίος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 14 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and gives no years. It is plainly the same prophet: the son of Shaphat, servant and successor of Elijah, who received a double portion of his grace. The page also lists a separate commemoration, the deposition of the relics of the apostles Luke, Andrew and Thomas, of the prophet Elisha and of the martyr Lazarus, which is not this day's entry and is not recorded here. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 27.06.2026 (14. јун ст. ст.) — „Свети пророк Јелисеј“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry. The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, without a closing full stop, as every heading of this wave is. The Julian 14 June is the same menologion number this folder’s other venerated row carries, so there is no second day and no §4 note is owed. A FIRST DATE ON A FOLDER THAT HELD NONE, AND IT IS BC. The folder carried no `dates` object at all. This book opens the entry with one flat and round: „Живео на девет стотина година пре Христа“. `floruit` -900 to -900, display «about 900 BC», basis traditional, the sentence in the note; the Serbian „на“ is what makes it «about» and not a point. **No `death` and no `birth`**: the entry ends „Представио се у дубокој старости“, a deep old age and not a year, and a lifespan is refused as it was on Onuphrius two days ago. HIS CALL, AND THE ONE `related` ROW IS ALREADY THERE. „Господ хтео узети к Себи престарелог пророка Илију“ and revealed to him that Elisha son of Shaphat, of the tribe of Reuben, from the city of Abel-meholah, was appointed his successor in the prophetic office; Elijah told him the Lord’s will, threw his mantle over him and asked of God a double prophetic grace for him; Elisha left house and kindred at once and followed him; and when the Lord took Elijah up in the fiery chariot he stayed to carry the office on with greater power than Elijah’s. `elijah-the-tishbite` is already in this folder’s `related` and nothing is added; the call is written into the life with its link. **The tribe and the city are new to the folder and no `locations` is written for them**, because a birthplace named in one clause with nothing to bound it is not a coordinate. TWELVE WONDERS THE ENTRY ENUMERATES, AND THEY ARE THE BULK OF WHAT IS NEW: the Jordan divided; the bitter water at Jericho made sweet; water brought down into dug trenches in the war with the Moabites; the oil multiplied in a poor widow’s pots; the Shunammite woman’s dead son raised; a hundred men fed with twenty little loaves; the commander Неман healed of leprosy; the leprosy brought down on his own servant Гиезије for love of silver; one whole Syrian army blinded and another put to flight; and many things foretold both to the people and to individuals. He was the equal of the greatest prophets in purity and zeal, the entry says, and surpassed them all in the wonder-working power given him by God. NO ROWS, AND ONE NAME DELIBERATELY KEPT OUT OF THE PROSE. The dividing of the Jordan is compared to „као негда Мојсеј у Црвеном мору“; `moses-the-prophet` exists, **a simile is not a relation**, and because `related-floor` reads a prose name as well as a linked one the comparison is written in the life without the name. Naaman, Gehazi, the Shunammite woman and the widow are in the life and no folder holds any of them. No `office`, no `locations`. `types` UNTOUCHED: пророк is `prophet`, which is there. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse.

hymns.text: Ὡς ὑποφήτην ἀληθῆ τοῦ Σωτῆρος, καὶ τῶν ἐν νόμῳ παιδευτὴν καὶ φωστῆρα, τοὶς πόρρω σὲ ἐδήλωσεν ὁ τόκος σου σοφὲ σὺ γὰρ κληρωσάμενος, τοῦ Θεσβίτου τὴν χάριν, θαύμασι διέπρεψας, καὶ δυνάμεσι πλείσταις. Καὶ νῦν ἀπαύστως φύλαττε ἠμᾶς, ὢ Ἐλισαῖε, Προφῆτα θεσπέσιε.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ὁ ὑψωθεῖς ἐν τῷ Σταυρῷ — the first of two apolytikia on the page of «Προφήτης Ελισσαίος», and it names him

english.text: Your own birth made you known to those far off, O wise one, as a true interpreter of the Saviour and as a teacher and luminary of those under the law; for having inherited the Tishbite's grace, you excelled in wonders and in very many mighty works. And now guard us unceasingly, O Elisha, divinely-speaking prophet.

hymns.text: Προφήτης Θεοῦ, ἐδείχθεις διπλασίονα, τὴν χάριν λαβών, τὴν ὄντως ἐπαξίαν σοι, Ἐλισσαῖε μακάριε. Ἠλιοῦ γὰρ γέγονας σύσκηνος, σὺν αὐτῷ Χριστῷ τῷ Θεῷ, πρεσβεύων ἀπαύστως ὑπὲρ πάντων ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος β’, Τὰ ἄνω ζητῶν — the first of two kontakia on the page of «Προφήτης Ελισσαίος», and it names him

english.text: You were shown a prophet of God, having received the double grace that was truly worthy of you, O blessed Elisha; for you became Elijah's tent-fellow, interceding with him unceasingly before Christ our God for us all.

hymns.text: Иже во плоти Ангел/ и пророков начальнику свидетельствова, славный Елисее,/ дивны чудеса соделал еси, пророче,/ поспешеством Святаго Духа;/ силою Илииною исцелив водное естество,/ звери же погуби пожирающия,/ и Неемана очисти,/ и вдовича сына воскресил еси,/ и всем чтущим тя даруй благодать и исцеление.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, «Ин тропарь пророка Елисея», глас 4, under «Молитвы» on the day page for 14 июня ст. ст.. It addresses him in the vocative, «славный Елисее», so it is his own proper; the other troparion the page prints under his name is the prophet Елия’s and is not kept here.

english.text: O glorious Elisha, who didst bear witness to him that was an angel in the flesh and the chief of the prophets, thou didst work wondrous miracles, O prophet, by the aid of the Holy Spirit: by the power of Elias thou didst heal the nature of the waters, and destroy the beasts that devoured, and cleanse Naaman, and raise the widow’s son; and to all that honour thee grant grace and healing.

hymns.text: Пророк Божий явился еси,/ сугубую благодать прием,/ воистинну достойную тебе, Елиссее блаженне:/ Илии бо был еси совсельник,// с нимже Христу Богу молися непрестанно о всех нас.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, «Кондак пророка Елисея», глас 2, under «Молитвы» on the day page for 14 июня ст. ст.. It names him in the vocative, «Елиссее блаженне», so it is his own proper.

english.text: Thou wast shown to be a prophet of God, receiving the double portion of grace that was truly worthy of thee, O blessed Elisha; for thou wast the fellow-dweller of Elias: with him pray unceasingly to Christ God for us all.

floruit.note: The Охридски пролог for 14. јун ст. ст. opens the entry „Живео на девет стотина година пре Христа“ — he lived about nine hundred years before Christ. The folder held no date of any kind before this: neither doxologia.ro nor saint.gr gave a year. The same entry ends „Представио се у дубокој старости“, which is an old age and not a year, so there is no `death` and no `birth` (5 October 2026).
